objectives: Identify spl as the onset in taught words.
Compare rimes in splat and split.
Decode each complete word rather than guessing from the onset.
Explain how vowel and ending evidence distinguish words.
concepts: The onset is the consonant blend before the vowel.
The rime includes the vowel and following sounds.
Words may share an onset but have different rimes.
Whole-word decoding checks onset, vowel, and ending.

definitions.definition: The consonant sound or blend before the vowel.
The vowel and any sounds that follow it.
Words grouped by a shared rime or spelling pattern.
